cross-border-intel 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a localized intelligence tool for cross-border sellers, focused on Amazon and TikTok tracking.
- Enables monitoring of Amazon ASIN price, BSR, and review changes, plus TikTok product trends.
- Provides commands to add, remove, list, and report on tracked ASINs or keywords.
- Supports immediate and scheduled scans; issues alerts for significant changes.
- Delivers daily and weekly automated scanning and reporting routines.
